400.title: Bad request
400.msg: The request for ${context} contains invalid syntax.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.msg: Valid authentication credentials are required for ${context}.

408.title: Request timeout
408.msg: The server timed out waiting for ${context}.

502.title: Bad gateway
502.msg: The server received an invalid response from the upstream server for ${context}.

503.title: Service unavailable
503.msg: The server is temporarily unable to process ${context}.

504.title: Gateway timeout
504.msg: The upstream server failed to respond in time for ${context}.

404.title: Not found
404.msg: The requested item ${context} does not exist.

403.title: Forbidden
403.msg: You do not have permission to access this resource.

416.title: Range error
416.msg: The server couldn't stream the requested file chunk.

500.title: Server error
500.msg: The server encountered an internal glitch.
